description: This file contains a Java class named CurrencyUpdateCommandHandler which implements a command handler interface to process currency update requests. It uses Spring annotations for component and transaction management, and it delegates the update logic to a service.

classes.name: CurrencyUpdateCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class responsible for handling currency update commands, orchestrating the service call to update allowed currencies.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the currency update command by calling the service to update allowed currencies based on the command's payload.
